description: Veyra Canonical Target Manifest defining forecast bust and failure labels across variables and hazards.

invariants.temporal_safety: Target variables can only be computed when verification ground truth is available (valid_time + latency).
invariants.feature_target_isolation: No target-derived variables or ground-truth residuals may be present in issue-time feature sets.
invariants.evaluation_contract: All challengers and incumbent baselines must evaluate against these exact target definitions.

targets.description: Primary V3 binary bust indicator: absolute forecast error exceeds the 95th percentile historical error for the specific lead and climate stratum.
Precipitation bust indicator: 24h accumulated rainfall error exceeds 50mm or stratum-specific 95th percentile error.
Tropical cyclone bust: track position error exceeds 100km at 48h or intensity error exceeds 15 knots (7.7 m/s).
Monsoon Low Pressure System bust: genesis timing error exceeds 24h or trough center placement exceeds 200km.
Western Disturbance bust: trough arrival timing error exceeds 12h or orographic precipitation error exceeds 25mm/24h.
Heatwave bust: failure to predict heatwave conditions (Tmax >= 40°C & anomaly >= 4.5°C) or false alarm with > 3.0 K overprediction.
Severe wind bust: failure to predict gale-force gusts (>= 17.2 m/s) or gust speed error exceeding 6 m/s.
